Separate outputs are `04-raw-input-Evidence.md`/Journal and `06-raw-input-Evidence.md`/Journal. Reader01 keeps only already-read input P0001-P0013. This is an ownership transfer, not a completion claim. Complete parser/IDs/aliases stay unchanged; no input payload beyond P0013 will be substantively reread by reader01.

Latest ownership override: assistant `P0006-P0872` belongs exclusively to the lead, recorded in `00-raw-assistant-Evidence.md`. Reader01 has already read assistant P0001-P0005 and retains only those five assistant paragraphs. Reader05 still owns thinking P2001-P4084. All IDs/parser data below stay unchanged; metadata and other retained categories remain reader01-owned.

Substantive reading and exact consumed spans are established in `01-raw-context-Evidence.md`/Journal, not by this index. Other ownership and completion belong to the separate00/04/05/06 Evidence/Journal artifacts; only the lead assistant completion has been explicitly reported here.

Source: docs_PRD04/raw-research-evidence-dump-2026-07-26.txt, physical lines 1-12296 inclusive. SHA-256: 474a45f214d771e8e733ad9384dd02b6fa329e5cfcbe6649913a4ad84e1f3bce. IDs are assigned separately per category, in first raw occurrence order. JSON pointers use RFC 6901 escaping. Decoded line ranges count LF-separated lines after removing line terminators, not raw physical lines.

Exclusions: all tool-result content, toolUseResult top-level aliases, StructuredOutput input objects, and workflow-journal result objects. Their non-payload metadata remains in scope. Ordinary tool inputs are canonical JSON with recursively sorted object keys and unchanged array order, then exact-value deduplicated; no fuzzy matching. Empty strings are indexed as fields but have no nonblank paragraphs. Paragraphs are maximal nonblank decoded line runs, preserving internal whitespace. Deduplication is within each category, not a claim that categories have no overlap.

## Reproduction

The Ruby analysis recipe below only reads the archive into memory. It executes no archived command. ROOTS, UNITS, PARAS, META, RECORDS, OTHER and EXCLUDED are analysis data; no source/output file is written. For bounded consumption select PARAS[category] IDs, print a text slice using 1-based character boundaries, and retain the ID and boundaries. Do not print an unbounded raw JSONL line. Do not publish thinking transcripts; ledger observations must summarize only historical assertions or conclusions.

```ruby
require 'json'
require 'digest'
SRC="docs_PRD04/raw-research-evidence-dump-2026-07-26.txt"
ROOTS=[]; META=[]; EMPTY_META=[]; EXCLUDED=Hash.new(0); RECORDS=[]; OTHER=[]; file=nil
def canonical(x)
 case x
 when Hash then x.keys.sort.map{|k| [k,canonical(x[k])]}.to_h
 when Array then x.map{|v| canonical(v)}
 else x
 end
end
def root(cat,v,n,ptr,file,agent)
 return if v.nil?
 s=v.is_a?(String) ? v : JSON.generate(canonical(v))
 ROOTS << {cat:cat,text:s,line:n,ptr:ptr,file:file,agent:agent}
end
def meta(x,n,p,file)
 EMPTY_META << {line:n,ptr:p,file:file,type:x.class.name} if (x.is_a?(Hash) || x.is_a?(Array)) && x.empty?
 case x
 when Hash then x.each{|k,v| meta(v,n,p+"/"+k.to_s.gsub("~","~0").gsub("/","~1"),file)}
 when Array then x.each_with_index{|v,i| meta(v,n,p+"/"+i.to_s,file)}
 else META << {line:n,ptr:p,file:file,value:x}
 end
end
File.foreach(SRC, encoding: "UTF-8").with_index(1) do |s,n|
 break if n>12296
 if s.start_with?("--- FILE:")
  file=s.strip.sub("--- FILE: ","")
 end
 unless s.lstrip.start_with?("{")
  OTHER << {line:n,text:s.chomp}
  next
 end
 x=JSON.parse(s); RECORDS << {line:n,file:file,type:x["type"],agent:x["agentId"]}
 x=x.dup; agent=x["agentId"]
 if file.end_with?("journal.jsonl")
  EXCLUDED[:journal_results]+=1 if x.delete("result")
 end
 a=x.delete("attachment")
 if a
  a=a.dup
  %w[content stdout stderr].each do |k|
   if a.key?(k)
    root("attachment",a.delete(k),n,"/attachment/"+k,file,agent)
   end
  end
  meta(a,n,"/attachment",file)
 end
 m=x.delete("message")
 if m
  m=m.dup; content=m.delete("content")
  if content.is_a?(String)
   root("prompt",content,n,"/message/content",file,agent)
  elsif content.is_a?(Array)
   content.each_with_index do |b,i|
    b=b.dup; p="/message/content/#{i}"
    case b["type"]
    when "text"
     root(x["type"]=="assistant" ? "assistant" : "user_text",b.delete("text"),n,p+"/text",file,agent)
    when "thinking"
     root("thinking",b.delete("thinking"),n,p+"/thinking",file,agent)
    when "tool_use"
     if b["name"]=="StructuredOutput"
      EXCLUDED[:structured_inputs]+=1
      b.delete("input")
     else
      root("tool_input",b.delete("input"),n,p+"/input",file,agent)
     end
    when "tool_result"
     EXCLUDED[:tool_results]+=1
     b.delete("content")
    else
     raise "unclassified block #{n} #{b.keys}"
    end
    meta(b,n,p,file)
   end
  elsif !content.nil?
   raise "unclassified message #{n}"
  end
  meta(m,n,"/message",file)
 end
 EXCLUDED[:tool_use_result_aliases]+=1 if x.key?("toolUseResult")
 x.delete("toolUseResult")
 meta(x,n,"",file)
end
CATS=%w[prompt user_text assistant thinking attachment tool_input]
UNITS={}; PARAS={}
CATS.each do |cat|
 seen={}; items=[]
 ROOTS.select{|r|r[:cat]==cat}.each do |r|
  key=r[:text]
  if seen.key?(key)
   items[seen[key]][:occurrences]<<r.reject{|k,v| k==:text || k==:cat}
  else
   seen[key]=items.length
   items << {id:"#{cat}-#{format('%04d',items.length+1)}",text:key,sha256:Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(key),occurrences:[r.reject{|k,v|k==:text || k==:cat}]}
  end
 end
 UNITS[cat]=items
 ps={}; plist=[]
 items.each do |u|
  ls=u[:text].lines.map{|s|s.chomp}; start=nil
  (0..ls.length).each do |i|
   if i<ls.length && !ls[i].strip.empty?
    start=i if start.nil?
   elsif start
    value=ls[start...i].join("\n"); occurrence={unit:u[:id],decoded_lines:[start+1,i]}
    if ps.key?(value)
     plist[ps[value]][:occurrences]<<occurrence
    else
     ps[value]=plist.length
     plist << {id:"#{cat}-P#{format('%04d',plist.length+1)}",text:value,sha256:Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(value),occurrences:[occurrence]}
    end
    start=nil
   end
  end
 end
 PARAS[cat]=plist
end
```

## Metadata Schemas

Structural coverage only, not substantive reading of every record. Opaque signatures, IDs, timestamps, token counters, and booleans are inspected as machine evidence. Their ranges and representative values require separate ledger acknowledgement. Tool errors here are status metadata, not read tool-result payloads.

Empty metadata containers are explicitly inspected in addition to the 349,170 scalar leaves: `/attachment/removedNames` is `[]` at 194 occurrences (first raw 22, last 12103), `/attachment/readdedNames` is `[]` at the same 194 occurrences, and `/message/usage/iterations` is `[]` at 2,710 occurrences (first raw 24, last 12125).
